Eastbrook University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
Emergency Department - Clerking Proforma
Ed Clerking - 06/03/2020 01:11
Hospital No: 00393b70-eb5e-4075-9348-cabfbc8ce514
Doc: 00393b70-eb5e-4075-9348-cabfbc8ce514 ed_clerking
06/03/2020 01:11
Presenting complaint: Woman in her 20s-30s presenting with cough, fever and progressive
breathlessness.
History: Four-day history of dry cough and fever, with breathlessness worsening over the
previous 24 hours. No significant past medical history, non-smoker. Swab for SARS-CoV-2
PCR taken 13:08 on 05/03/2020 during initial assessment. Laboratory warned of a possible
backlog but the result was reported within the day. Result confirmed positive, reported 20:40
on 05/03/2020.
Observations: Temperature 38.6°C, HR 118 bpm, RR 30/min, BP 110/64 mmHg, SpO2
dropped to 88% on air recorded at 21:30 on 05/03/2020, improved to 93% on 4L nasal
cannula. NEWS2 score 8.
Examination: Marked tachypnoea, widespread bilateral crackles, using accessory muscles.
Alert, no confusion, peripherally warm.
Impression: Confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia with significant hypoxia and high NEWS2,
concerning for deterioration.
Plan: Admit urgently for oxygen therapy and close monitoring. Bed initially unavailable on
AMU; a side room was found and the patient transferred within the hour. Admitted to
hospital at 00:11 on 06/03/2020. VTE risk assessment: high risk, thromboprophylaxis to be
prescribed on the ward. Chest X-ray and bloods sent including FBC, CRP, U&E, D-dimer,
ABG. Critical care outreach informed given high NEWS2 for early review. Escalation plan and
ceiling of care to be discussed on the ward.
Ed Clerking
